decisions.label: See-through reach
decisions.note: How far past her the soft see-through circle reaches, a share of her size (occlusion.edge, 0.8 as ever). If the circle bug's ring grows and shrinks with this, the ring is the see-through's own edge (Ed, 2026-10-14).

decisions.label: See-through opacity
decisions.note: How solid things in front of her stay at the circle's middle (occlusion.fadeOpacity, 0.38 as ever; 1: not see-through at all, though still drawn in the see-through pass).

decisions.label: See-through fade
decisions.note: Off: things in front of her stay solid and in the solid pass (the fade alone off; everything else of the see-through as ever). On as ever.

decisions.label: Mark see-through pixels
decisions.note: On: every pixel the see-through pass draws tinted magenta, to see whether the circle bug's ring is exactly that pass's edge. Off as ever.

decisions.label: Low mist
decisions.note: The low drifting mist (part of the smooth effects layer). On as ever; off to see if the circle round her goes (Ed, 2026-10-14).

decisions.label: Light rings
decisions.note: The faint moonlight rings on the crowns (part of the smooth effects layer). On as ever; off to see if the circle round her goes (Ed, 2026-10-14).
